cards.title: Document / Style
cards.body:
Character lineup model sheet · concept art sheet
#14 · Gouache-Fantasy-Art · Legend of Mana
PlayStation · 32-bit era
Artist ref: Shinichi Kameoka · character design
Signature: Luminous storybook color, warm fine contours

cards.title: Lineart
cards.body:
Fine sepia / charcoal brushlike contour
Delicate painted edge rhythm
Gouache illustration, not pixel art

cards.title: Morphology
cards.body:
Adult human design stays fixed
Tall, slim ectomorph with long limbs
No fantasy anatomy or costume redesign

cards.title: Shading
cards.body:
Opaque hand-painted gouache color planes
Luminous, restrained fantasy palette
Visible but controlled brush texture

cards.title: Biotype
cards.body:
Selected: tall, slim ectomorph
Options: ectomorph · mesomorph · endomorph
muscular · petite · slim · athletic · curvy
heavy muscular · short

cards.title: Relative Scale
cards.body:
H = crown-to-chin head height · target ~7.5H
Orthographic views share scale and baseline
Visual guide, not canonical absolute height

cards.title: Palette / Effects
cards.body:
Fixed identity colors: blue/cyan, white, gray, burgundy, brown
Brass hardware; gouache light only, no costume recolor
Concept illustration; colors not quantized

cards.title: Background / Alignment
cards.body:
Clean neutral cream · no scenery or texture
Horizontal lineup · common scale and baseline

cards.title: Fixed Character Details
cards.body:
Gray hair · round brass glasses · cane · rapier
Steel crescent boomerang · fully human; no monster traits

artistic_style_reference.reference_role_and_scope: Main character designer for Legend of Mana, per Square Enix creator comment.
style_signature: hand-painted gouache color planes with warm fine contours
luminous storybook fantasy color with controlled texture
distinctive character silhouettes and readable costume shapes
artistic_style_reference.basis_and_limits: Editorial visual-analysis descriptors; the source confirms character-design role, not sole authorship of every asset.

annotation_revision.preserved_artwork_note: The concept artwork is from the recorded raw source; labels and style metadata are compositor overlays.
